title: The Switch Plate
summary: Your round-1 pick kept as you chose it (Before on paper, After on ink, six shifts row against row), with the logo symbol removed, the head matched to the hero, and one quiet Before → After switch in which each row's two voices trade size in place, 01 → 06, while the plates re-proportion.

reference.site: Round 1 · A ('Two-Plate Operating State'), harmonised with the A×C system
reference.borrowed: From round-1 A, everything you picked. That means the two flat plates on the 12 columns (a paper --panel plate for 'without the system' and an ink plate for 'with it', split 5 | 7 at rest), the six shifts aligned row against row on hairline rules, the two voices (Mona light for 'without', the wide display cut for 'with'), and the Before | After control that re-proportions the plates and hands the large voice to whichever side leads. It also keeps the source copy: 'Same activity. / Different system.', the lede and the 'The difference' note.
reference.kelwin: The section is now built on the shared A×C kit. The head uses the hero's grammar: a red-square caps label with a mono FIG. number at right, an 88px two-voice statement with one light accent line, the 48×2 rule and a 20px lede in cols 1–6. The round-1 side note is dropped because it restated the statement a third time. The plate heads and caption are the kit's mono caption, and the control is the Plurel segmented control. DIRECTION-AC makes this one of two deliberately drawing-free sections, so the page can breathe here. The lead device is type on a switch plate. The three-piece mark that sat in the ink plate's head (with its red core) is removed and nothing stands in for it; the leading plate's head simply brightens to --fg. Row labels are 12px mono at .10em tracking, so TARGETING, MESSAGING and the rest read at a glance. The figure has no red. Red appears only in the family punctuation: the label square and the rule.

motion: entrance: the kit runs the head. The label row fades in, then 'Same activity.' rises out of its mask, with 'Different system.' (light) 200ms later. The red rule draws and the lede fades up 12px. The two plates wipe open top-down (800ms, the ink plate 120ms after the paper one) in the Before arrangement: the paper plate leads at 7 columns in the large light voice (32px) and the ink plate trails at 5. The plate heads fade in, then the rows follow the wipe in reading order, 01 → 06, 60ms apart: each row's hairline draws left to right (600ms --ease-inout) and its key and voices fade in. The caption and control settle last. Before holds, fully readable, for about 0.8s.

orchestrated moment (the switch, at 2.6s): the control's ink fill moves from Before to After (500ms). The text never leaves the plates. Row by row, 01 → 06, 60ms apart, the paper plate's voice settles from 32px --fg to 17px --fg-2 in place (600ms --ease-inout, a scale from its left edge). From 150ms the plates re-proportion across the seam, 7 | 5 → 5 | 7 columns (900ms --ease-inout). From 250ms each row's two hairlines are wiped toward the right and redrawn from the left, in the same 01 → 06 wave. From 400ms the ink plate's wide voice swells from 17px --fg-2 to 32px --fg, 01 → 06, and the ink plate's head brightens to --fg. The switch lands by about 3.95s.

interaction: Before | After are real buttons (aria-pressed). Either direction plays the same sequence mirrored, and because every step is a CSS transition, a second click mid-switch simply reverses it (no lock, no dead clicks). A click cancels the pending demo switch. Hovering a row lifts its mono label from --fg-2 to --fg. The pressed button keeps its ink label under the pointer.

on the live site: the rows draw in on Before and the figure switches to After once, when it is 40% visible (IntersectionObserver), with no pin. After that, the reader drives it. There is no ambient loop. With reduced motion, the resting After state renders synchronously, with no entrance, no timers and instant switches.
notes: The figure number follows round-2 order (hero FIG. 01 … assets FIG. 10, before/after FIG. 11). The plate is 488px: a 56px head, 6 × 60px rows and a 72px caption band, so the control sits 12px clear of the last rule. Each voice is one element set at 32px (the kit's H3 tier); the trailing state is a scale of 17/32 from its left edge, so the resting 17px text stays crisp and the swap is a morph rather than a fade-out/fade-in. Both voices are always on screen, so every frame reads as six without → with pairs. There are no doors in this head: the FAQ and the full-red final CTA follow immediately, and three asks in a row would read as pressure. Kit note: in kit-ac.css, '.ac-seg > button:hover' out-ranks the pressed state, so hovering a selected segment paints its label --fg on an --fg fill (blank). This section overrides it locally; the kit rule should be fixed for every section. Fit check at 32px: the longest line keeps at least 46px of room in the Swiss skin and 16px in the Kelwin skin, in both the Before (7 | 5) and After (5 | 7) arrangements.
addressed: Kept as you picked it: two plates face to face, Before on paper and After on ink, with the six shifts row against row and the Before | After switch.
The logo symbol is gone from the After plate, and nothing stands in for it. The plate head simply reads 'After · with the system' and brightens when that side leads.
The head now matches the hero: red-square label, a two-line statement with one light line, the red rule and the lede.
The side note ('The activity can look the same…') is removed. It said the headline a third time; the head now runs statement, lede, then the proof.

The switch no longer empties the plates. Row by row, 01 → 06, the old voice settles small and the new one grows large in place while the plates re-proportion and each rule redraws, so the text stays readable throughout.
Row labels (Targeting, Messaging…) are 12px mono with tight tracking, so they read at a glance.
There is no red inside the figure, only paper and ink. The label square and the rule are the only red touches.
Fixed a control glitch: hovering the selected Before/After button no longer blanks its label.

Final coherence pass: the leading voice is now 32px, the same size as the other 32px headings on the page (the 'How it closes' heading, the method's phase names, the footer's column titles), instead of a one-off 28px. The plates also sit 64px under the head, the same step every other section uses.
